title: Jury convicts Blaise Taylor of murdering his pregnant girlfriend

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Former Titans scout Taylor found guilty of murder
sources.description: Blaise Taylor, a former defensive back at Arkansas State and NFL scout for the Titans, was found guilty of murdering his girlfriend and her unborn child Wednesday in a Nashville courtroom.
